statements.quote: We anticipate our full year 2025 capital expenditures will be in the range of $60-65 billion.
statements.notes: Total capex guidance, not AI spend. The sentence itself does not mention AI; the link to generative AI is in the next sentence of the same passage.

statements.quote: We expect capital expenditures growth in 2025 will be driven by increased investment to support both our generative AI efforts and core business.
statements.notes: Names generative AI as one of two drivers of capex growth, with no AI amount or share. The following sentence says the majority of 2025 capex goes to the core business; no AI share is inferred from it.

statements.quote: We expect employee compensation to be the second-largest factor as we add technical talent in the priority areas of infrastructure, monetization, Reality Labs, generative artificial intelligence (AI), as well as regulation and compliance.
statements.notes: Headcount expense growth is attributed to hiring in several priority areas, and generative AI is one of five. The AI link is weak and unquantified.
